scope: Independent second read of S2/F2/R2/R5, four tasks each, in current pilot96. Only these report files written; source tasks, catalog and authoritative reviews not modified.
catalog_identity_policy: Task IDs and immutable source blobs are the audit unit; catalog overall file may be reassembled as replay reports arrive.

findings.finding: R5 task definition supported, but source teacher replaces both primary and legacy fallback with new namespace; do not admit this as a complete compatibility-positive repair. Strict-warning baseline failure remains an inference, not an observed source run.
F2 root-state isolation is one component, but wrong requirement.package edge independently prevents traversal. No single-action causal pair may be claimed.
Mutant retains formatted line/column strings. Missing structured position attributes and constructor/callsite contract are the failure; use these as the discriminator.

Independent review found dotted-repository splitting incorrectly set PDFminer repo_snapshot_prefix/snapshot_group_id to six instead of 1a8bd2f7. Root corrected build_inventory parsing and authoritative SF JSON/JSONL, then reassembled catalog; this review re-read the corrected values. Exact original task blobs and execution identity never changed.

limits: This is a static source/identity review, not a new execution or a policy rollout.

Fixed dataset revision/split are cross-checked against current pinned acquisition metadata; this round did not re-download HuggingFace or re-run git ls-remote. Raw HF rows do not themselves authenticate a dataset revision.
Publisher resolved is never substituted for official replay. Native physical split=tool is kept separate from train-candidate usage.
Original F2P/P2P counts and identity were compared; source commands were not executed, required nodes were not dropped, no tests were written.
No heldout or official public129 content was read; no GPU or paid model sampling was started.

Six causal fields mean trigger, wrong base behavior, production symbols, causal change, discriminating observation, and source/verification scope. Planned/static observations are explicitly separated from actually observed reports.

Native23 reports the regular-package case succeeds, but the combined custom-ZIP case still fails at23/31/49. Isolated custom-ZIP executions27/45/71/75/79 and rerun77 succeed. These are source observations, not original F2P/P2P validation.
